Connect this app?

An app on your computer or phone is asking to use your Mail Shield account.

“Example App”

This is the name the app gives itself. Mail Shield has not checked who it is.

It sends you back to example.com when you are done.

What the app may do

Anything this app reads is sent to whoever runs it, outside Mail Shield. Only connect an app you trust.
